The '''MK series''' was a series of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], and they were only differentiated from conventional [[Droid/Legends|droids]] by their name, which commemorated the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kirlocca]]<ref name="Force Convergence" /> following his death around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The droids were on sale from by [[Joh's New and Used Droid Emporium]], a business based on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], during a celebration that was held on Cularin in honor of Kirlocca's life<ref name="Force Convergence" /> and became the fastest&ndash;selling line of droids ever produced in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="Fun and Profit">{{LivingForce|For Fun and Profit}}</ref> During the [[Cularin Trade Show]], which was held in the Cularin system aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[TAV Prosperity|TAV ''Prosperity'']], a rumor spread that Joh's had sold out of the commemorative droids.<ref name="Fun and Profit" />

==Behind the scenes==
The MK series was first mentioned in ''[[Force Convergence]]'', an interactive [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] scenario that supplemented the [[Forces of Cularin trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force campaign]].<ref name="Force Convergence" />
